context: 9pm. Hiroshi (the boss) has called Kenji back to the office. A client crisis has hit and someone is going to have to fix it overnight.
purpose: workplace urgency — boss asking subordinate to take a hit, calmly

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 佐藤くん、夜遅くにすまない。
lines.en: Sato-kun — sorry to call you back so late.
lines.style: Composed but warmer than his daytime voice. Real apology underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いえ、大丈夫です。何ですか？
lines.en: No — it's fine. What is it?
lines.style: Bag still on shoulder. Voice neutral, professional.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: クライアントの件。明日朝までに、修正が必要だ。
lines.en: The client matter. Needs fixing by tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Plain, no extra weight. The information first.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Sits down in the voice. Calculating.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 正直、大きい。本当に申し訳ない。
lines.style: The 「本当に」 rare from this man. Sincere.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: わかりました。私、やります。
lines.style: Quiet professional commitment. No theatre — as the scene allows it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: A small statement that changes the conversation entirely.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: …部長も？本当にいいんですか。
lines.en: …You too, sir? Really, is that alright?
lines.style: Genuinely surprised. The first real human note from him in the scene.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 私が頼んだ仕事だ。当然だろう。
lines.en: It's work I asked of you. Of course.
lines.style: Plain, firm. Self-evident logic, by his code.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。…正直、助かります。
lines.style: A small unguarded line. Bag finally set down in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: コーヒー淹れた。…時間、節約しよう。
lines.style: A small practical kindness covering a larger one.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。…大変ですけど、なんとかなる。
lines.en: Yes. …It's a lot, but we'll manage.
lines.style: Rolling sleeves up in the voice. Quietly determined.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるさ。明日の朝、笑える。
lines.en: We will. We'll be laughing tomorrow morning.
lines.style: A small uncharacteristic promise. Voice slightly warmer.
